name: Dias
introduce:
HU-35 Dias
A heavy ST produced by the UKB-1, and ordered and equipped by the NDF.
The Dias is equipped with the "Bloodlust" core and was initially smuggled into the UNCS for use in underground mech fights. The UNCS military has since seized these black market STs and integrated them into its fighting force.

20194.name: Bloodlust Unit
20194.SpecificEffects: After being attacked, gain DMG <color=#F74848>+6%</color> after combat, up to <color=#F74848>5</color> stacks, lasting for <color=#F74848>1</color> turn.

30138.name: Retaliation Mod
30138.SpecificEffects:
When retaliating, DMG <color=#F74848>+18%</color>.
Additionally, [Quick Draw] effective times per turn <color=#F74848>+1</color>.
